title: Linked List Cycle
prompt: Given head, the head of a linked list, determine if the linked list has a cycle in it. There is a cycle in a linked list if there is some node in the list that can be reached again by continuously following the next pointer.
hints: Floyd's cycle detection: use slow and fast pointers. Slow moves 1, fast moves 2.
If there is a cycle, slow and fast will eventually meet. If fast reaches null, no cycle.
Why it works: in each step, the distance between fast and slow decreases by 1 (fast gains 1 step on slow).
